    arm_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.upper + p.lower) / 2 for p in arm_patches]

    min_distance = float('inf')

        for arm_center in arm_centers:

            distance_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy
            
            if distance_squared < min_distance:
                min_distance = distance_squared
                best_match = arm_patches[arm_centers.index(arm_center)]
    
    return best_match
